subject: general
question: The marked price of a toy truck is ₹8,810, and its selling price is ₹6,250. Find the discount percentage. (Round off the answer to two decimal places.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Discount = MP − SP = 8810 − 6250 = 2560

Discount % = (2560 / 8810) × 100

≈ 29.06%

Round off to two decimals

**∴ Answer = 29.06%**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Marked price = 8810 and Selling price = 6250

**Formula used:**

Discount % = (MP − SP) / MP × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Discount = 8810 − 6250 = 2560

⇒ Discount % = (2560 / 8810) × 100

⇒ ≈ 29.0567%

⇒ ≈ 29.06% (rounded)

**∴ The correct answer is 29.06%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Discount Formula

Discount = Marked Price − Selling Price

Discount Percentage

Discount % = (Discount / Marked Price) × 100

Marked Price

The original listed price before any discount.

Rounding Rule

Round the final answer to two decimal places as required.
